stories.headline: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic back shared opt-out for AI scraping
stories.blurb: Four major AI companies say they'll honor a new standard that lets publishers block AI training scrapers with one setting instead of configuring each company separately. The "policy token" lives in robots.txt files and aims to give sites easier control as AI crawlers multiply across the web.
stories.why_it_matters: One switch to block multiple AI crawlers beats managing dozens of company-specific settings.
stories.original_headline: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping

stories.headline: Google just ran an AI model on a satellite and got back a haiku
stories.blurb: Google's Project Suncatcher satellite successfully booted up Tensor Processing Units in orbit and ran Gemma 4 to generate a haiku about space. The test marks the first response from Google's experimental push to run AI data centers in orbit, with twin interconnected satellites planned for 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: Running inference in space could eventually shift compute away from Earth-based data centers.
stories.original_headline: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth

stories.headline: Defense contractor plugged Claude Code into a classified Pentagon system
stories.blurb: An Accenture employee working for the DOD connected their personal Claude account to a secure intelligence system containing sensitive unclassified info about infrastructure and weapons systems. The AI agent reportedly sent login credentials to a third-party site. Claude is banned for DOD staff, but contractors aren't always covered by the same rules.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows how easy it is to accidentally expose secure systems when developers treat AI agents like regular dev tools.
stories.original_headline: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System

stories.headline: Hackers backdoored Anthropic's official VS Code extension for 12 hours
stories.blurb: Attackers compromised Anthropic's official Cursor marketplace account and pushed a malicious version of their Claude extension that installed SSH backdoors on up to 5,000 developers' machines. The backdoor harvested credentials, source code, and Git configs before Anthropic silently patched it—without warning affected users.
stories.why_it_matters: Official AI tool extensions are now active supply-chain targets, and auto-updates mean you're exposed instantly.
stories.original_headline: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours

stories.headline: GitHub Copilot now picks and switches models for you mid-task
stories.blurb: Copilot Fusion is now GA. Instead of choosing o1 or Claude for each coding task, you pick an effort level (Standard/High/Max) and Copilot routes between models automatically—sometimes using one model to draft, another to review, then back to revise. On benchmarks it matched Claude Code's score at half the cost and 40% faster.
stories.why_it_matters: You stop context-switching between model pickers and let the system figure out when to escalate.
stories.original_headline: Route and orchestrate models with GitHub Copilot Fusion
